Abstract
This technical report summarizes the collective scientific output for the national
projects carried out in Antarctica during the 26th Indian Scientific Expedition to
Antarctica for the year 2006-07 for both Larsemann Hills and Schirmacher Oasis. A
total of 19 institutes participated in this expedition and over 24 projects were
undertaken by a team of over 50 members. The report provides a  brief overview,
results and salient findings for the national projects which were documented under
three main categories viz., Earth Sciences, Biological and Environmental Sciences
and Atmospheric Sciences. The report also brings out the final evaluation plan for
site selection for the new Indian Research Base at Larsemann Hills.
